#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::cin.ignore(); // ignore newline after n
    std::string ip;
    std::getline(std::cin, ip);

    int wordCount = 0;
    int longestWord = 0;
    bool insideBraces = false;
    std::string currentWord;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        char ch = ip[i];

        if (ch == '_') {
            int wordLength = currentWord.length();
            if (wordLength > 0) {
                if (insideBraces) {
                    wordCount++;
                } else {
                    longestWord = std::max(longestWord, wordLength);
                }
            }
            currentWord.clear();
        }

        if (ch == '(') {
            int wordLength = currentWord.length();
            if (wordLength > 0) {
                if (insideBraces) {
                    wordCount++;
                } else {
                    longestWord = std::max(longestWord, wordLength);
                }
            }
            currentWord.clear();
            insideBraces = true;
        }

        if (ch == ')') {
            int wordLength = currentWord.length();
            if (wordLength > 0) {
                if (insideBraces) {
                    wordCount++;
                } else {
                    longestWord = std::max(longestWord, wordLength);
                }
            }
            currentWord.clear();
            insideBraces = false;
        }

        if ((ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') || (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z')) {
            currentWord.push_back(ch);
        }
    }

    int wordLength = currentWord.length();
    if (wordLength > 0) {
        if (insideBraces) {
            wordCount++;
        } else {
            longestWord = std::max(longestWord, wordLength);
        }
    }

    std::cout << longestWord << " " << wordCount << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
